facts.text: Deborah takes her cats for a run in the park every morning and evening.

evidence.quote: Exercise and nature are really important to me, so I make sure to take them out for a run in the park every morning and evening.

facts.text: Deborah has two cats that are sitting on a couch with a blanket.

evidence.quote: I haven't introduced you to my pets yet! I don't like dogs, that's why I have cats.
[image: a photography of two cats sitting on a couch with a blanket]

facts.text: Deborah finds peace in nature every day.

evidence.quote: Nature helps me find peace every day - it's so refreshing!
